cases.title: A downpipe and a raingarden place on empty ground with no pipe to join, nothing is refused, and one U takes back only the raingarden
cases.plan_item: UX-SRC-05 (daily card D07); BUG-176 (CDRG no longer needs a pipe)
cases.expected: DP at 150000,-80000 prints 'Downpipe placed. Tag: DP<n>. Nothing nearby. The source connects when a pipe is drawn to it.' and offers the next DP; Esc stops it; one new DOWNPIPE DYNAMIC WITH MASK insert exists. CDRG with the four corners 160000,-80000 / 164000,-80000 / 164000,-77000 / 160000,-77000, C (Close) and Skip at the GIO question prints 'Raingarden RG<n> placed. 4 vertices, 12.0 m2' (square metres), with no 'CDRG command cancelled.' and no error; the object count rises; one U echoes CDRG and the object count returns to the count after the downpipe (the downpipe stays).
cases.why_not_unit: The placement route depends on the live drawing having no pipe near the point to split or join, and the outline is collected by a live drag prompt.
not_automated: A drawing with NO pipe at all (the card's blank fixture F-BLANK) is not used: the runner has no blank DRV master. Codex D7-01 covered the blank drawing on 3.0.78 (DIFFERENT only on the unitless-area wording).
The RG plan label and the raingarden's look are not judged (Codex D7-01 could not read the RG1 label; a picture item).
